;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019–2021 Iraqi protests]]
**A drone attacks the home of prominent [[Shia Islam|Shia]] cleric [[Muqtada al-Sadr]], leaving no casualties and causing minimal damage. The attack follows yesterday's incident in [[Baghdad]] when multiple protesters were fired upon and killed. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-protests-baghdad/rocket-hits-iraqi-clerics-home-following-deadly-baghdad-attack-idUSKBN1YB09W (Reuters)]
*[[Afghan peace process]]
**The [[Taliban]] announce that the peace talks with the [[United States]] resumed "from where they stopped" in September. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/12/07/politics/us-taliban-peace-talks-resume-doha-qatar/index.html (CNN)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018–19 Southern Africa drought]]
**An unprecedented [[drought]] in [[Zimbabwe]], considered the worst in a century, causes the [[Victoria Falls]] [[waterfall]] on the [[Zambezi]] river to nearly stop flowing. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/dec/07/victoria-falls-dries-to-a-trickle-after-worst-drought-in-a-century (''The Guardian'')]
*A woman is killed and 18 other people injured when a bus crashes with a truck in [[Milan]], [[Italy]]. [http://www.ansa.it/lombardia/notizie/2019/12/07/scontro-bus-camion-rifiuti-feriti_b566a1a7-0fe6-4eeb-b062-052f928302e6.html (Ansa)]


;International relations
*[[Iran–United States relations]]
**In an act of cooperation that is rare in recent years, [[Iran]] releases [[Princeton University|Princeton]] PhD candidate [[Xiyue Wang|Wang Xiyue]] while the [[United States]] releases [[stem cell]] researcher Massoud Soleimani in a [[prisoner exchange]]. Both [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] and [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian Foreign Minister]] [[Mohammad Javad Zarif]] thank the [[Switzerland|Swiss]] government for facilitating the swap. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-usa-prisoners/united-states-and-iran-swap-prisoners-in-rare-act-of-cooperation-idUSKBN1YB08X (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Rohingya genocide]]
**[[Myanmar]]'s [[Aung San Suu Kyi]] travels to [[The Hague]] where she is expected to face [[genocide]] charges against her government for the alleged crimes committed against the [[Rohingya]] [[Islam in Myanmar|Muslim]] minority, in what is described as one of the most-high profile international legal cases in a generation. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/12/07/aung-san-suu-kyi-fight-genocide-charges-hague/ (''The Telegraph'')]
*Two [[Indigenous peoples in Brazil|indigenous]] leaders from the [[Guajajara]] tribe are shot dead in a [[drive-by shooting]] on a federal highway in [[Brazil]]'s [[Maranhão]] state. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/dec/08/amazon-indigenous-leaders-killed-in-brazil-drive-by-shooting (''The Guardian'')]
